purpose: Define Trigger as an explicit declarative matcher/condition over Events or state, separate from the execution it may request.

topics.name: Trigger Identity
topics.purpose: Define Trigger as an explicit declarative matcher/condition over Events or state, separate from the execution it may request.

semantics.identity_rule: Every Trigger has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.match_rule: Trigger declares exact Event type/topic/source/condition semantics.
semantics.condition_rule: Conditions are explicit machine-readable predicates, not hidden code heuristics.
semantics.result_rule: Trigger match produces a trigger-fired result/event/request, not direct arbitrary execution.
semantics.target_rule: Execution target is an explicit runner/routine/operation binding.
semantics.authority_rule: Trigger binding does not derive authority from Event payload.
semantics.state_rule: Enabled/disabled/runtime-fired state is separate from Trigger definition.

invariants.rule: Event, Trigger, Runner and resulting Event are separate explicit identities connected only by declared causality edges; matching or adjacency never implies execution.

hard_gates.condition: trigger target hidden in payload text
trigger match directly executes arbitrary code
trigger identity inferred from file name

prose.summary: Define Trigger as an explicit declarative matcher/condition over Events or state, separate from the execution it may request.
